name: musicdeck
description: Root convenience scripts for running the MusicDeck webapp and server together during local development.

scripts.start: cargo build --manifest-path server-rust/Cargo.toml --bin musicdeck-server && concurrently -n server,webapp -c blue,green "cargo run --manifest-path server-rust/Cargo.toml --bin musicdeck-server" "npm start --prefix webapp"
scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path server-rust/Cargo.toml --bins && npm run build --prefix webapp
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path server-rust/Cargo.toml && npm test --prefix webapp
